messages:
lina_cs: Heads-up: starting an automated sweep to surface "onboarding_stuck" accounts (no product_activity + no owner for >14 days). Goal: auto-tag, attempt owner-assign via owner-heuristics, then push remainder to cs-onboard-review. Need sign-off on sampling and safeguards.

vignesh_ops: SGTM. What are the guardrails? We should exclude GDPR opt-outs and accounts with legal_hold=true. Also limit to ARR >= $250.

nora_data: Propose deterministic sample by hashing account_id % 100 < 6 so we can reproduce. Add filter events_last_14d = 0 and created_at > '2025-01-01'. I'll emit metrics: candidate_count, assigned_by_heuristic, review_queue_size.

todd_eng: Infra notes: owner-heuristics service will accept up to 120 ids/batch. We need idempotency and DLQ on topic cs.onboard.sweep.dead. Will add rate-limit and a LaunchDarkly flag onboard_sweep_v1.

lina_cs: SQL prototype for dry-run:

```sql
SELECT account_id
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE primary_owner IS NULL
  AND product_usage_count = 0
  AND (murmurhash(account_id)::bigint % 100) < 6
  AND opt_out = false
  AND legal_hold = false
  AND arr_monthly >= 250
  AND created_at >= '2025-01-01';
```

nora_data: tiny tweak: prefer events_last_14d is null OR = 0 rather than product_usage_count. I'll add a Join to last_event_ts to be precise. Also tag run_id=onboard_sweep_20260323.

vignesh_ops: Operationally: SLA for manual review should be 72h for the pilot. @todd_eng can we provide a Slack shortcut that creates a ticket in the cs-onboard-review queue when someone claims it?

todd_eng: Yes. I'll add a workspace shortcut and an Asana template. Also will wire a monitor alert if review_queue_size > 250.

ascent-bot: Scheduler created: onboard-sweep-scheduler -> 08:30 UTC daily, dry_run=true for 48h, notify #csops-alerts.

lina_cs: I'll run manual smoke checks on 50 stratified accounts after the dry-run (verify owner accuracy, no PII leak, correct tags). If green, we'll flip LD flag to enable 6% sample and run for 7 days.

nora_data: I'll add dashboards and an alert: enrich_error_rate > 3% or heuristic_assign_accuracy < 70% triggers rollback.

vignesh_ops: Add privacy contact in the run doc and rollback steps: flip LD off, cancel scheduler, send DLQ to audit folder.

lina_cs: Thanks team 44d I'll post the doc PR and drop a short summary in #eng-prod when ready.
